summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a Form 6-K confirming open-market repurchases under its share buyback programme announced 17 February 2026, with an aggregate cap of EUR 1 billion. Between 14 and 18 September 2026 the company bought 305,000 ordinary shares on US venues and 92,500 on London venues from Goldman Sachs entities, cancelling all repurchased shares. Weighted-average prices ranged from USD 99.98 to USD 105.19 and GBP 74.91 to GBP 77.71. No board recommendation or advisor is cited beyond the programme; the risk-arb focus is buyback pace versus the EUR 1 billion authorization and cancellation-driven share count reduction.
